title: The pizza place on Cypress
logline: A pizza place on a side street the strip never drew, its window with a wooden machine in it — a cabinet with a screen and a slot — and an old man behind the counter from behind. The page draws the machine the way it drew the jukebox in the plaster: as a shape it can hear.

panels.composition: A pizza restaurant's window on a side street with a wooden cabinet holding a small screen and a slot visible inside, an old man from behind at the counter, evening.
